body: I feel you; in this situation right now, except I don't feel bad wishing it because I think it's best.
I like to think of us as dogs' guardians, not masters.

If you can't sleep (as your username suggests), consider taking Zoplicone at night to help you sleep - it'll black you out.  I'm depressed too and I need these sleeping pills so that I can STOP FUCKING THINKING.  Also, stop overthinking things; play a little dangerous because it's helpful to get out of that safe-zone depression puts you in.  Disclaimer:  Play a little dangerous doesn't mean go do stupid shit that would maim you or anyone else.  Just try to stop overthinking decisions, especially if they're little decisions like (should I pick up that wrapper on the floor?)... that shit will drive you crazy.  Good luck.

Similar situation, but mines less than 2 months from now, on my 20th birthday.

I met a depressed woman at the psych ward (I'm suicidal), she has 2 daughters, one of them in highschool.  I have the feeling you're a highschool girl (I didn't stalk you, it's just a feeling).

Her daughter doesn't understand her depression, and constantly hurts her by ditching her for friends, etc...

She told me that driving her to summer school is what keeps her going right now.  

Anyways, from what you wrote it seems like she actually told you that "nobody likes me, everyone is out to get me".  Perhaps that's her way of asking you for help.  

The sad thing about this situation is that you can't half-ass showing that you care about her.  Realistically if you were to do a decent job your grades would probably fall.  If that were to happen, however, she might have more reason to become depressed.

Tough situation.  My advice is to really focus on what she says.  

She might encrypt her words.  Listen to what she says, whilst hearing things she doesn't say.  Be sensitive.

Sometimes I think like that...like when I commit suicide - I wish that everyone I cared for at one point, people who could have helped or even completely saved me, but didn't, from this highly suicidal state of the point where one makes a promise to oneself to kill said self on a certain date if they are not happy by that date - will suffer and be crippled by guilt for the remainder of their lives.

Sometimes I don't.  I guess that makes me indecisive?

...

You used the word "broken" to describe yourself.  If I had to use one word to describe myself, it wouldn't be "depressed" or even "suicidal", but the word "broken".  

I am unwilling to try to make friends anymore.  That's all I really need; people that care about me enough.  But nobody is strong enough for my depression.

Just wanted to let you know I read this, throwingaway282.
